title: CMH Hospice Lights of Remembrance
seo_title: CMH Hospice Lights of Remembrance in Bolivar, MO
description: Lights of Remembrance is Citizens Memorial Hospice's annual holiday-season evening of reflection and celebration that honors loved ones who have passed and supports CMH Hospice's mission. The program features music from the Bolivar High School Chamber Choir, the Bolivar Intermediate School Ringers, and Ron George, plus awards for compassion, service and partnership in hospice care, and refreshments will be served. The public is invited to attend on November 16, 2026 (time TBD) at Citizens Memorial Hospital, 1500 N Oakland Ave in Bolivar, Missouri.
